title: GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion in One Day 🤯
youtube_title: GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion in One Day 🤯
youtube_description:
GTA 6 made $3.79 billion in day one retail sales. That is Take-Two's own company estimate, counted through the end of day on November 19, 2026, worldwide. It is retail sales (what stores and digital storefronts took in), not Take-Two's profit, and not a count of copies.

Take-Two calls it "the biggest entertainment launch in history" and "a new record for entertainment across any medium". That is Take-Two's claim.

For scale, GTA 5 in 2013: more than $800 million on its first day (excluding Japan and Brazil, which launched later), and more than $1 billion after its first three days. Both are Take-Two estimates too, in 2013 dollars, not adjusted for inflation. So GTA 6 passed three billion in a single day.

Did you buy GTA 6 on day one? Yes or not yet?

Numbers as Take-Two published them on November 20, 2026 and September 18 and 20, 2013. Company estimates can be revised.

Sources:
- Take-Two Interactive, Grand Theft Auto VI Shatters Entertainment Box Office Records with $3.79 Billion in Day One Retail Sales (Nov 20, 2026, read Nov 21, 2026): https://www.take2games.com/ir/news/grand-theft-auto-vi-shatters-entertainment-box-office-records
- Business Wire, the same release: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261120446139/en/
- Take-Two Interactive, Grand Theft Auto V Retail Sales Exceed $800 Million Worldwide During First Day of Launch (Sept 18, 2013, SEC filing, read Nov 21, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000946581/000110465913070819/a13-20938_1ex99d1.htm
- Take-Two Interactive, Grand Theft Auto V Worldwide Sales Surpass $1 Billion In First Three Days (Sept 20, 2013, SEC filing, read Nov 21, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/946581/000110465913071387/a13-21085_1ex99d1.htm
